fusions.name: Touch It Off
fusions.desc: Throws a spark that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it, and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Spring Cleaning
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Sets the web around you alight, which deals 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Smoulder Fence
fusions.desc: Strings a burning line 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Anything that crosses it is [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Singed Retort
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a burning thread lashes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, which deals 6 damage and leaves it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
